current_answer: As of 27 October 2026, public evidence still does not establish broad capability decline across popular AI models. OpenAI’s 7 October system card reports statistically significant regressions for GPT-6 Sol and Luna in selected safety evaluations against GPT-5.6, alongside better factuality on nearly all of its difficult test metrics and less over-refusal. These are narrow provider evaluations, not estimates of typical production behavior; some system safeguards are excluded. OpenAI says the October snapshots replaced GPT-5.6 in ChatGPT while Work and Codex still used September versions, so the surfaces cannot be treated as the same release. Recent English- and Spanish-language community posts report context, memory, style, and correction problems, but provide no matched replay or denominator. OpenAI’s current status page is investigating hosted Code Review/Security Review errors on private GitHub repositories; that is a service issue, not evidence of GPT-6 Chat quality. Before switching, record the exact surface, model label, task, context, and whether the response completed; compare a safe repeatable task and score correctness, safety, completion, and correction cost separately.

catalogue_card.question: Did GPT-6 get worse, or did one safety measure move?
catalogue_card.text: OpenAI reports narrow GPT-6 safety regressions beside factuality gains and fewer unnecessary refusals. The card does not show a broad capability decline.

summary: Broad capability decline across popular AI models is not established as of 27 October 2026.
OpenAI reports statistically significant regressions in selected standard and under-18 safety tests for the GPT-6 October versions.
The same card reports factuality gains across nearly all of its difficult test metrics and less over-refusal; these tests do not estimate typical production use.
OpenAI says October GPT-6 versions went to ChatGPT while Work and Codex remained on September versions at publication.
Recent English- and Spanish-language user posts describe memory/context, tone, correction, and task completion concerns; they are not matched tests.
An active OpenAI Status investigation concerns hosted Code Reviews and Security Reviews on private GitHub repositories, not a GPT-6 Chat quality evaluation.
AgentCheck’s latest shown daily 20-prompt monitor covers selected Anthropic models and does not measure GPT-6.
For a switching decision, compare the same safe task on the actual surface, record completion separately from quality, and count correction cost.
uncertainty: OpenAI’s system card is provider-authored. It reports difficult evaluation results, not prevalence in ordinary ChatGPT use, and its published evaluations do not include some system-level safeguards.
The reported GPT-6 regressions are in specified safety categories. The same card reports factuality and helpfulness gains; neither result proves a broad change in general capability.

OpenAI states that ChatGPT received October GPT-6 versions while Work and Codex remained on September versions at the time of publication; a current user’s served model and route should be checked rather than inferred from a family label.
Recent Reddit and community posts are self-selected reports without saved matched outputs, verified serving identity, independent replication, or population denominators.
AgentCheck’s daily 20-prompt exact-golden panel covers selected Anthropic models, not GPT-6 or multi-turn ChatGPT workflows; its stable result does not test the reported complaints.
OpenAI’s active status investigation concerns hosted Code Reviews and Security Reviews on private GitHub repositories; it does not report a GPT-6 Chat answer-quality issue.
First-party pool analytics were unavailable, so discovery, reader actions, repeat use, switching, and revenue remain unknown.
freshness_note: Reviewed 27 October 2026. OpenAI’s release card adds a narrow, measured safety regression alongside factuality gains and lower over-refusal. The affected test categories and the ChatGPT-versus-Work/Codex release boundary matter; broad model decline remains unestablished.
